forcedChoices.reason: English 'Be you perfect' does not mark number; the injunction is to all mortals, so plural ustedes per the Spanish rules.
English singular 'You, being a creature' addresses the reader; the rules ask for plural ustedes when the text speaks to the reader.
'assigned on any single mission' can modify the chief or the Evangels; Spanish agreement forces one; plural keeps the Evangels as the ones assigned to a mission, which 31:7.2 supports.
'authorized so to function' can refer to the One without Name and Number or to both sponsors; Spanish number forces a choice; plural follows the joint sponsorship.
Spanish puts the era mark after the year; the span tag is kept and moved with its text.
The English ordinal suffix 'th' becomes the Spanish ordinal mark 'o' inside the same sup tag.
